# Grofolio

> Grofolio (https://www.grofolio.tech/) — Ready to Grow Your Business? Discover Smarter Marketing Strategies. Explore practical digital marketing insights, expert strategies, and actionable guides to grow your online presence, reach more customers, and generate leads.

## Key Information
- Domain: https://www.grofolio.tech/
- Focus: Practical digital marketing strategies, Global Brand Building, Technical SEO, Google Search Console, B2B lead generation, search intent optimization, conversion funnels, CAC/LTV performance.
- Standards: Real-world tested, fluff-free, conversion-focused, transparent trade-offs.

## Core Articles
- [ChatGPT Business Hub the End of Google My Business? What Local & Online Brands Need to Know](https://www.grofolio.tech/blogs/chatgpt-business-hub-the-end-of-google-my-business/): Deep analysis of OpenAI's ChatGPT Business Hub beta, comparing its conversational discovery engine with Google Business Profile, outlining its 5 core capabilities (entity verification, facts management, analytics, discovery topics, and AI business agents), and providing an actionable dual-visibility framework.
- [How Coca-Cola Uses Marketing Strategies to Build a Global Brand](https://www.grofolio.tech/blogs/coca-cola-marketing-strategy/): In-depth case study analyzing Coca-Cola's core marketing pillars—personalized packaging (Share a Coke), emotional advertising, social media participation, and visual brand consistency—with actionable lessons for small businesses.
- [Why Google Shows Old Titles After Updating a Page](https://www.grofolio.tech/blogs/google-showing-old-title-after-update/): Complete technical SEO guide to diagnosing why Google displays outdated page titles, addressing algorithmic title rewriting, handling the 160 vs 55 indexed URL discrepancy, and using GSC URL Inspection and Removals tools effectively.
- [B2B Digital Marketing Strategy: Practical Framework for Sustainable Lead Generation](https://www.grofolio.tech/blogs/b2b-digital-marketing-strategy/): Complete guide to building a predictable 3-tier inbound engine covering demand creation, commercial intent capture, and pipeline conversion without burning ad spend.
